folder_html:
LIVE CLOUD COVER

Hourly HRRR cloud analysis: how much of the sky over the Great Lakes basin is cloud-covered right now, in percent as filed by NOAA. Clear areas are transparent so the map underneath shows through.

Cloud cover (%, as filed by HRRR): LOWEST 0 clear transparent → thin cloud dark-blue/blue/cyan → 40 green → 55 yellow → 70 orange → 82 red → 90 magenta → HIGHEST+ 100 overcast dark-purple. Same % always shows the same color; clear areas stay see-through.

Units: % cloud cover
